    button.Text = defaultText
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    button.TextSize = 13
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
    button.AutoButtonColor = false

    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    corner.Parent = button

    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 56, 61)
    stroke.Parent = button

    circle.Parent = switch

    local cCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    cCorner.Parent = circle

    local function updateToggleVisual()
        local targetColor = state and Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 215) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 61, 66)
        local targetPos = state and UDim2.new(1, -13, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)

        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(circle, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Position = targetPos}):Play()
        task.spawn(callback, state)
    end

    toggleFrame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        updateToggleVisual()
    end)

    TranslateRefs[textKey] = titleLabel
    toggleFrame.Parent = parent
    task.spawn(callback, state)
    return toggleFrame

    valueLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)

    TranslateRefs[textKey] = titleLabel

        valueLabel.Text = tostring(sliderValue)

    end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        if isSliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

            isSliding = false
        end
    end)

-- =============================================================================
-- LOGIC KIỂM SOÁT HITBOX CHI TIẾT
-- =============================================================================
local function savedPart(player, part)
    pcall(function()
        if not hitbox_original_properties[player] then
            hitbox_original_properties[player] = {}
        end
        if not hitbox_original_properties[player][part.Name] then
            hitbox_original_properties[player][part.Name] = {
                CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
                Transparency = part.Transparency,
                Size = part.Size
            }
        end
    end)
end

local function restoredPart(player)
    pcall(function()
        if hitbox_original_properties[player] then
            for partName, properties in pairs(hitbox_original_properties[player]) do
                local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(partName)
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = properties.CanCollide
                    part.Transparency = properties.Transparency
                    part.Size = properties.Size
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function findClosestPart(player, partName)
    local target = nil
    pcall(function()
        if player.Character then
            for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name:lower():match(partName:lower()) then
                    target = part
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    return target
end

local function isEnemy(player)
    if teamCheck == "FFA" or teamCheck == "Everyone" then
        return true
    end
    return player.Team ~= LocalPlayer.Team
end

local function extendHitbox(player)
    pcall(function()
        for _, partName in ipairs(defaultBodyParts) do
            local part = player.Character and (player.Character:FindFirstChild(partName) or findClosestPart(player, partName))
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                savedPart(player, part)
                part.CanCollide = not noCollisionEnabled
                part.Transparency = hitboxTransparency / 10
                part.Size = Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function updateHitboxes()
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if v ~= LocalPlayer and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                if isEnemy(v) then
                    extendHitbox(v)
                else
                    restoredPart(v)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function checkForDeadPlayers()
    for player, properties in pairs(hitbox_original_properties) do
        pcall(function()
            if not player or not player.Parent or not player.Character or not player.Character:IsDescendantOf(game) then
                restoredPart(player)
                hitbox_original_properties[player] = nil
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Tìm đối thủ gần tâm chuột nhất phục vụ Aim Assist
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function getClosestPlayerToCursor()
    local closestTarget = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local targetPartName = aimbotTargetPart
            if targetPartName == "Random" then
                local parts = {"Head", "UpperTorso", "HumanoidRootPart"}
                targetPartName = parts[math.random(1, #parts)]
            end
            
            local lockPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild(targetPartName)
            if lockPart then
                local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    if not aimbotTeamCheck or player.Team ~= LocalPlayer.Team then
                        local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(lockPart.Position)
                        
                        if onScreen then
                            local screenVector = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                            local dist = (screenVector - mousePos).Magnitude
                            if dist < aimbotFOV and dist < shortestDistance then
                                shortestDistance = dist
                                closestTarget = lockPart
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closestTarget
end

            local targetDir = (target.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
            local nextLook = currentCamLook:Lerp(targetDir, aimbotSmoothness)
            camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, camera.CFrame.Position + nextLook)
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(step)
    if fly_flying and fly_c and fly_c.PrimaryPart then
        local rootPos = fly_c.PrimaryPart.Position
        local cf = fly_cam.CFrame
        local ax, ay, az = cf:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
        fly_c:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(rootPos.X, rootPos.Y, rootPos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(ax, ay, az))
        
        if fly_buttons.Moving then
            local t = Vector3.new()
            if fly_buttons.W then t = t + (cf.LookVector * (flySettings.flyspeed / cf.LookVector.Magnitude)) end
            if fly_buttons.S then t = t - (cf.LookVector * (flySettings.flyspeed / cf.LookVector.Magnitude)) end
            if fly_buttons.A then t = t - (cf.RightVector * (flySettings.flyspeed / cf.RightVector.Magnitude)) end
            if fly_buttons.D then t = t + (cf.RightVector * (flySettings.flyspeed / cf.RightVector.Magnitude)) end
            fly_c:TranslateBy(t * step)
        end
    end
end)
